Visual verification: Only ONE route line visible on map after second calculation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs verified fixed. Bug 1: marker_icon and marker_color now persist correctly when editing stations. Bug 2: Route replacement works - new routes replace old ones without overlay. All core features working: route calculation, fuel planning, station CRUD, city search.

bug_1.root_cause: FuelStationUpdate Pydantic model was missing marker_icon and marker_color fields
bug_1.fix: Added Optional[str] fields for marker_icon and marker_color to FuelStationUpdate model
bug_1.verification: API now accepts and persists these fields on PUT requests

bug_2.root_cause: Polyline component had static key, causing React to not re-render when route changed
bug_2.fix: Added dynamic key based on route geometry hash to force re-render
bug_2.verification: Visual test confirmed only one route line visible after calculating second route
